title.rendered: Meet ntop at RIPE 61 Rome (15-19 November)

content.rendered: Those who are interested in hearing about high-speed packet capture and filtering and to monitoring in general, can show up at the next RIPE 61 meeting that till take place in Rome (15-19 November). I will be speaking about hardware packet filtering using commodity adapters and how this work can be used in real life, ranging from ntop/nProbe to snort and network troubleshooting.
